# Columns (TAB): LAYER  main|overlay  register  field  TRUE|FALSE|number  required|optional  basis

# i % (windows/heads) of head i / (windows/heads) (ogkm nvkms-rm.c ProbeHeadCountAndWindowAssignment).
# Register/field names are the class header's own (class prefix dropped); the loader refuses a name the
# family's header lacks unless the row is `optional`. A row claims only what kayfabe's engine implements.
# Only rows that a hardware bisection showed the Windows display driver needs are here
# (docs/design/V3_DISPLAY_CAPS_DERIVATION_20261014.md §3); the rest of the measured page is not claimed.
